item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "6afcb100c72e5487e24a3d93ceb1c85accc8890a110f37cd7e9cad1d0bf6ada9",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "Abbreviation for LocalDef003 applied to a function from real numbers to m-component real states and two specified states.",
      "effect_on_target": "The left side of the equivalence requires initialState to equal leftState at every negative input and rightState at every positive input.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "For any state type, constructs the function assigning leftState when x < 0, rightState when 0 < x, and valueAtOrigin otherwise, hence at x = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "The right side asserts equality of initialState with this three-case function for some m-component real state valueAtOrigin.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "The conjunction that data x = leftState for every real x < 0 and data x = rightState for every real x > 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specifies both half-line conditions and places no condition on data at zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "State equalities mean equality of every component; the conclusion's function equality means equality at every real input and every component, including at zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification: some object of the specified type satisfies the predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Quantifies one state valueAtOrigin of type Fin m → Real, inside the universal quantifiers for m, initialState, leftState, and rightState.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "Fin m is the finite index type consisting of natural numbers strictly less than m.",
      "effect_on_target": "States have m real components indexed by 0 through m − 1; when m = 0, the index type is empty.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "Iff",
      "meaning": "Logical equivalence, asserting implication in both directions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Asserts that the half-line conditions are both necessary and sufficient for the existential piecewise representation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers, including zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "The dimension m is universally quantified over all nonnegative integers, without a positivity assumption.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both the independent variable and all state components are real-valued.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "LT.lt",
      "meaning": "Projects the strict comparison relation from a supplied LT instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "With Real.instLT, gives the strict inequalities delimiting the negative and positive half-lines.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Projects the value interpreting a natural-number literal in a type from its OfNat instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the literal 0 in the comparisons as real zero through the supplied zero instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "Real.decidableLT",
      "meaning": "Supplies a decision instance for strict comparison of two real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Enables the conditional branches defining LocalDef002; adds no hypothesis restricting the inputs.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Real.instLT",
      "meaning": "The strict-order instance on real numbers, whose relation is Real.lt.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the comparisons in both local definitions comparisons in the usual strict order of the reals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The zero instance for real numbers, supplying Real.zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the dividing point of the two half-lines and the exceptional point as real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Converts a Zero instance into an interpretation of the numeral 0 using that instance's zero element.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the written numeral 0 to the real zero supplied by Real.instZero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "ite",
      "meaning": "A conditional returning its first value when its proposition is true and its second value when it is false.",
      "effect_on_target": "The nested conditionals select leftState for x < 0, then rightState for x > 0, and valueAtOrigin when neither strict inequality holds.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction, requiring both propositions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires both the negative-half-line and positive-half-line conditions simultaneously.",
      "status": "understood"
    }
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "For every natural number m ≥ 0, implicitly bound in Lean.",
      "For every function initialState : ℝ → (Fin m → ℝ).",
      "For every pair of states leftState, rightState : Fin m → ℝ.",
      "Within the half-line conditions, x ranges universally over ℝ.",
      "On the right side of the equivalence, there exists a state valueAtOrigin : Fin m → ℝ. This witness is quantified after m, initialState, leftState, and rightState and may depend on them; it is a single state, not a separate choice for each x."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "There are no additional hypotheses on the universally quantified data.",
      "The left side of the equivalence is the conjunction: for every real x, x < 0 implies initialState(x) = leftState; and for every real x, 0 < x implies initialState(x) = rightState."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "The two half-line conditions hold if and only if there exists a state valueAtOrigin such that initialState equals the function taking leftState for x < 0, valueAtOrigin for x = 0, and rightState for x > 0.",
      "Equality is exact at every real input and every component. Any witness necessarily equals initialState(0)."
    ],
    "mathematical_definitions": [
      "An m-component real state is a function on Fin m, the indices i satisfying 0 ≤ i < m, with values in ℝ.",
      "LocalDef001(initialState, leftState, rightState) abbreviates (∀ x < 0, initialState(x) = leftState) ∧ (∀ x > 0, initialState(x) = rightState).",
      "LocalDef002(leftState, valueAtOrigin, rightState)(x) is leftState if x < 0, rightState if x > 0, and valueAtOrigin if x = 0."
    ],
    "proposition_plain_english": "For every nonnegative integer m, every function initialState from the real line to m-component real states, and every pair of such states leftState and rightState, initialState is identically leftState on the strictly negative half-line and identically rightState on the strictly positive half-line if and only if there exists an m-component real state valueAtOrigin for which initialState is exactly the piecewise function with those two half-line values and value valueAtOrigin at zero."
  },
  "restrictions_and_vacuity_risks": [
    "The dimension m need not be positive. When m = 0, the state type has exactly one element, the empty function, so all state equalities and both sides of the equivalence hold automatically.",
    "The half-line conditions exclude zero. The original function's value at zero is unrestricted relative to leftState and rightState, but the existential representation must reproduce that value exactly.",
    "The two half-lines are nonempty, so their universal conditions are not vacuous because of their real input domains.",
    "No inequality or distinctness condition is imposed on leftState and rightState; they may coincide.",
    "The statement uses equality everywhere, not equality almost everywhere.",
    "No continuity, differentiability, differential equation, evolution in time, or additional physical interpretation of the states is encoded.",
    "Existence of the origin state is explicit; uniqueness is not explicitly asserted, although it follows from equality at zero."
  ],
  "ambiguities": []
}
